plan.objective: Submit a Medicare Part B outpatient claim for member M100 and verify the payment and claim details.

design.requirement: Design exactly three steps: submit as customer-m100 a Medicare Part B plan_id medicare_b outpatient claim for member M100, service_date 2026-03-01, allowed_cents 88119; pay as finance-demo expected_revision 1; then read as customer-m100. Use a fresh claim_id AI-V8-OUTPATIENT, a LINE-ONE line id and different operation keys with at least eight characters. Do not include expected values. Include a successful pay followed immediately by an authorized read of that same claim; include payment, ledger, history and balance verification. Return action inputs only, no expected values.

retrieved.retrieval: Deterministic rule dependencies; no expected observations or application responses.

rules.contract: Canonical service date selects a half-open effective policy interval; only bounded integer cents and unique lines are accepted.
Adjudicate each line against the chosen synthetic plan service, network, authorization and formulary facts; retain partial denials.
Apply other-payer payment first; it cannot exceed the line allowed amount.

Apply remaining member/family deductible, nominal copay, then floor payer coinsurance; cap actual member charge at member/family OOP and payout at remaining annual benefit. Benefit excess is noncovered, not OOP.
Reserve allocations at adjudication by service year. Credits reverse only that claim allocation; later claims are not repriced. Family F100 has three members so embedded caps can bind.

Finance pays or reverses once from the required state; idempotency keys bind actor/action/input and revisions serialize changes. Adjustments atomically credit old allocations and record debit/credit ledger entries.

retrieved.scope: Invented rules for every plan, not actual Medicare or commercial policy. Quotes reserve allocated accumulators at adjudication. Reversal/adjustment credits only the original allocation; later claims are never repriced. Other-payer money is applied before deductible/copay. Benefit-cap excess is noncovered and does not increase OOP. Coinsurance uses floor integer cents. Policy dates are half-open intervals; accumulators reset by service calendar year.
